notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
[b]Heyo People! :D[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157406/bf256c2a5b6ff5249f29682de3cf7ba28e1b1516.png[/img]

It's with great excitement that I came here to announce the first big content update for [b]Exterminant[/b]!
For the past 2 months, I've been cooking some content for you extermination enthusiasts.

Here is what you can expect in this update:

[list]
[*] 1 new world: [b]Mudlands[/b]
[*] 2 new enemy types
[*] 3 new guns to maximize destruction
[*] [b]Steam friends Leaderboards[/b]
[/list]

Note: Unfortunately, we had to change a few underlying systems of the game that caused a mass loss on saved progress, you may also expect a reset on your current progress, but I assure that this only happened on this update and further updates will try to be as compatible with old saves as possible
